youtube.title: Knuckles todne se Arthritis hota hai? 🤞 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Ek doctor ne sirf ek haath ke knuckles saath saal tak toode, sirf ek behes khatam karne ke liye. Bachpan mein Donald Unger ko unki maa aur massiyon ne daraya tha ki knuckles todoge to arthritis ho jayega. Unhone left haath ke knuckles roz kam se kam do baar toode, right haath ke kabhi nahi. Saath saal baad jaanch hui: kisi bhi haath mein arthritis nahi.

Awaaz kaise aati hai? Aapke joints ek fluid mein hote hain. Joint ko kheenchne par pressure gir jata hai, aur us fluid mein achanak gas ka bubble ban jata hai. Wahi aapko crack ki awaaz sunai deti hai. Aas-paas walon ko irritating lag sakta hai, par nuksaan? Shayad nahi.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
